newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lucky Man plans name change to DC Finance.
newsitem.headline: Lucky Man plans name change to DC Finance.

text.p: Lucky Man Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it proposed to change its corporate name to DC Finance (Holdings) Ltd, subject to shareholder approval.
It gave no details on time schedule.

Chairman Chan Yuen Tung said in a statement that the change was to enhance Lucky Man's corporate image and to signify its involvement in mortgage loan financing, property investment and development, and securities trading businesses.
Its shares eased HK$0.025 to HK$4.30 in early trade.
